newsitem.title: USA: National Steel names Maczuzak as president.
newsitem.headline: National Steel names Maczuzak as president.

text.p: National Steel Corp, the fourth largest integrated steel company in the United States, said on Tuesday that its directors have appointed John Maczuzak to the positions of president and chief operating officer.
Most recently, Maczuzak held the post of executive vice president and acting chief operating officer.

"Mr. Maczuzak has earned the confidence of our board of directors and has demonstrated the ability to successfully carry out the responsibilities of his new position," said Osamu Sawaragi, chairman of the board and chief executive officer, in a statement.
Maczuzak succeeds V. John Goodwin, who resigned as chief executive officer, president and chief operating officer in August. Goodwin remained as a consultant during the transition period.
National Steel has annual shipments of about 5.5 million tons of flat-rolled products. Its parent company is NKK Corp.
Shares of National Steel were trading up 1/8 to 9-3/4.
